Age.label: Age
Age.description: Age of the individual in years.

Tobacco Use.label: Tobacco Use
Tobacco Use.description: History or current use of tobacco products.

Alcohol Consumption.label: Alcohol Consumption
Alcohol Consumption.description: History or current consumption of alcoholic beverages.

Betel Quid Use.label: Betel Quid / Areca Nut Use
Betel Quid Use.description: Chewing betel quid, areca nut, or related preparations.

Chronic Sun Exposure.label: Chronic Sun Exposure
Chronic Sun Exposure.description: Frequent, long-term exposure to sunlight (relevant to lip cancers).

Poor Oral Hygiene.label: Oral Hygiene Level
Poor Oral Hygiene.description: General cleanliness and health status of the teeth and gums.

Diet (Fruits & Vegetables Intake).label: Dietary Habits (Fruit/Veggie Intake)
Diet (Fruits & Vegetables Intake).description: Frequency of intake of fresh fruits and vegetables.

Family History of Cancer.label: Family History of Cancer
Family History of Cancer.description: History of cancer among immediate or close relatives.

Compromised Immune System.label: Immune System Status
Compromised Immune System.description: Whether the immune system is weakened due to disease, medication, or therapy.

Oral Lesions.label: Oral Lesion Presence
Oral Lesions.description: Presence of any sores, ulcers, or persistent lesions in the mouth.

Unexplained Bleeding.label: Unexplained Oral Bleeding
Unexplained Bleeding.description: Bleeding from the mouth or gums that occurs without obvious trauma or injury.

Difficulty Swallowing.label: Difficulty Swallowing (Dysphagia)
Difficulty Swallowing.description: Difficulty or pain when swallowing food, liquids, or saliva.

White or Red Patches in Mouth.label: Persistent White/Red Patches
White or Red Patches in Mouth.dataset_column: White or Red Patches in Mouth
White or Red Patches in Mouth.description: Presence of white (leukoplakia) or red (erythroplakia) patches inside the oral cavity.
